data.title: Health insurer rejects co-payment exemption for 2025
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse rejected your application for exemption from co-payments (Zuzahlungsbefreiung) for 2025, dated 20 December 2024. Your co-payments did not reach the 2% limit of €748.20.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your co-payments have not reached the burden limit of 2% of annual gross income (€748.20), so no exemption is granted for 2025. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or on record at the insurer, within one month of the decision being deemed delivered. The app shows the deadline. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final. Keep your co-payment receipts. Consider advice if unsure.
